answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake in a crystal-clear escrow before it can earn: the stake acts like a walnut shell, hard to crack open cheaply, because opening thousands of fake identities means locking thousands of stakes. A slashing rule burns the stake of any identity caught submitting duplicate work, so a sybil tide of sockpuppets drains the attacker's own funds faster than it earns, while honest agents get their stake back with rewards.
